Importing and distributing since 1954

Three generations. It started with pepperoni.

In 1954, Giuseppe “Joe” and Raymond “Ray” Teolis began delivering fresh pepperoni to neighbourhood pizzerias. Those early customers helped shape the business that became Les Aliments Joe & Ray.

As their customers’ kitchens grew, so did the selection. Today we supply restaurants, caterers and retailers with deli meats, imported cheeses and Italian specialties.

Our third generation carries on the work in Saint-Léonard, with the same care for the products we carry and the people who serve them.

Frequently asked questions

Find answers to common questions about our products and services.

514.729.6470
What areas do you serve?

We provide distribution services throughout Quebec and surrounding areas.

Can I place a custom order?

Yes, we work with suppliers to source specialty products tailored to your business needs.

What are your delivery times?

Delivery times vary based on location, but we strive for prompt service within 1–2 business days.

Do you offer food safety programs?

Yes, we are CFIA-approved and provide comprehensive food safety and product recall programs.

What is your minimum order requirement?

The minimum order value is $500 for local deliveries.

Can I set up recurring orders?

Yes, we offer recurring delivery options for your convenience.

What products do you specialize in?

We specialize in deli meats, cheeses, and specialty imported food products.

How do I become a customer?

You can become a customer by filling out our contact form or giving us a call at 514.729.6470.

Do you offer sanitation and paper products?

Yes, we provide a wide range of sanitation and paper products for restaurants and food businesses.

Are your products locally sourced?

We offer a mix of locally sourced and imported products to meet your specific needs.
